a: Hatam, avud rabbanan milleta denicha leh lemocher venicha leh lelokeach.
Ittemar: achin shechalku, uva baal chov venatal chelko shel echad mehen; rav amar: batla machloket. ushemuel amar: vitter. verav assi amar: notel revia bekarka urevia bemaot.
Rav amar: batla machloket – ka savar: haachin shechalku, yorshin hen.
Ushemuel amar: vitter – ka savar: haachin shechalku lakochot havu, uchelokeach shello beachrayut dame.
Rav assi – mesappeka leh i yorshin havu i lakochot havu, hilkach notel revia bekarka urevia bemaot.
Amar rav pappa: hilcheta bechol hane shematata – mekammetzin. ammemar amar: batla machloket. vehilcheta: batla machloket.
Tanu rabbanan: shelosha sheyyardu lashum – echad omer bemane, ushenayim omrim bematayim; echad omer bematayim, ushenayim omrim bemane – batel yachid bemiuto.
Echad omer bemane, veechad omer beesrim, veechad omer bishloshim – niddon bemane. rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok omer: niddon betishim. acherim omrim: osin shuma benehen, umeshalleshin.
Man deamar niddon bemane – milleta metziata. rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok omer: niddon betishim – ka savar: ha ara –
b: Tishin shavya; vehay dekaamar esrim, deka tae asra laachoreh; vehay deka amar mane, ka tae asra lekammeh.
Adderabba! hay ara mea veasra shavya; vehay dekaamar mane – ka tae asra laachoreh, vehay dekaamar sheloshim – ka tae asra lekammeh! nekot mihat tere kammae bidach, demittorat mane la mappeki leh.

Acherim omrim: osin shuma benehen, umeshalleshin – ka savri: hay ara – tishin utelata vetilta shavya; hay deka amar esrim – ka tae telesar vetilta laachoreh, vehay dekaamar mane – ka tae telesar vetilta lekammeh; uvedin hu delema tefe, vehay dela kaamar, savar: missatay deka metappena kulle hay achavray.

Adderabba, ha ara – mea utelesar utelata shavya; hay dekaamar mane – ka tae telesar utelata laachoreh, vehay dekaamar sheloshim – tae telesar utelata lekammeh; uvedin hu dekaamar tefe, savar: missatay deka metappena kulle hay achavray! nekot mihat tere kammae bidach, demittorat mea la mappeki leh.

Amar rav huna: halacha kaacherim. amar rav ashe: tama daacherim la yadinan, hilcheta avdinan kevotayyhu?! tanu dayyayne gola: osin shuma benehen, umeshalleshin. amar rav huna: hilcheta kedayyayne gola. amar rav ashe: tama dedayyayne gola la yadinan, hilcheta avdinan kevotayyhu?!

Mishna haomer lachavero: "chatzi sade ani mocher lach" – meshammenin benehen, venotel chatzi sadehu. "chetzyah baddarom ani mocher lach" – meshammenin benehen, venotel chetzyah baddarom. vehu mekabbel alav mekom haggader, charitz uven charitz. vechamma hu charitz? shishsha tefachim. uven charitz – shelosha.

Gemara amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: lokeach notel kachush shebbo. amar leh rabbi chiyyay bar abba lerabbi yochanan: veha anan "meshammenin benehen" tenan! amar leh: addaachalt kafneyayta bevavel – targemna missefa,
Dekatane sefa: "chetzyah baddarom ani mocher lach" – meshammenin benehen venotel chetzyah baddarom. veammay meshammenin benehen? veha "chetzyah baddarom" amar leh! ella lidme; hacha name lidme.
Mekabbel alav mekom gader kulei. tana: charitz mibbachutz, uven charitz mibbifnim. veze vaze achore gader,

a: Kede shello tehe chayya kofetzet. velaaved charitz – vela laaved ben charitz! ayyeyde deravavch, kayyma begavveh vekaftza. velaaved ben charitz – vela laaved charitz! ayyeyde dekattin, kayyma assifteh vekaftza. vechamma ben charitz leven charitz? tefach.
Hadaran alach bet kor
Yesh nochalin umanchilin, veyesh nochalin velo manchilin; manchilin velo nochalin; lo nochalin velo manchilin.

Veellu nochalin umanchilin: haav et habbanim, vehabbanim et haav, vehaachin min haav – nochalin umanchilin. haish et immo, vehaish et ishto, uvene achayot – nochalin velo manchilin. haishsha et baneha, vehaishsha et balah, vaache haem – manchilin velo nochalin. vehaachin min haem – lo nochalin velo manchilin.
Gemara may shena dekatane "haav et habbanim" beresha? litne "habbanim et haav" beresha – chada, deatchole befureanuta la matchalinan;
b: Veod, kedichtiv: "ish ki yamut uven en lo" –
Vetanna, ayyeyde deatya leh midderasha – chaviva leh!
Umay derasha? detanya: "sheero" – ze haav; melammed shehaav kodem laachin. yachol yehe kodem labben? talmud lomar: "hakkarov" – karov karov kodem.
Uma raita lerabbot et habben, ulehotzi et haach? merabbe ani et habben – shekken kam tachat aviv liida velisde achuzza.
Adderabba! merabbe ani et haach, shekken kam tachat achiv leyibbum! kelum yesh yibbum – ella bemakom sheen ben, ha bemakom sheyyesh ben – en yibbum.
Tama deikka hay pircha, ha lav hachi – hava amena ach adif? tippok leh

a: Dehacha tarte, vehacha chada!
Sede achuzza gufa, mehay tama hu; deka kayyma leh letanna – kelum yesh yibbum ella bemakom sheen ben, ha yesh ben en yibbum.
Ema: "sheero" – ze haav, melammed shehaav kodem labbat. yachol yakdim labben? talmud lomar: "hakkarov" – karov karov kodem!
Kevan dilinyan yibbum – ben uvat ki hadade ninhu; leinyan nachala name, ben uvat ki hadade ninhu.
Veema: "sheero" – ze haav, melammed shehaav kodem laache haav. yachol yakdim laachin? talmud lomar: "hakkarov" – karov karov kodem!
Ache haav la tzerichi kera; ache haav mikkoach man ka atu – mikkoach av; kae av, ka yarti ache haav?!
Veha kerae lav hachi ketivi – dichtiv: "veim en achim leaviv vegomer"! kerae shello kesidran ketivi.

Vehay tanna mayyte la mehacha – detanya: et zo darash rabbi yishmael berabbi yose: "ish ki yamut uven en lo vegomer" – bimkom bat atta maavir nachala min haav, vei atta maavir nachala min haav bimkom achin.
Veema: bimkom bat atta maavir nachala min haachin,
b: Vei atta maavir nachala min haav afillu bimkom bat! im ken, la nichtov rachamana "vehaavartem"!
Uleman denafka leh mivhaavartem", hay "sheero" may aved leh? mibbee leh lechidtanya: "sheero" – zo ishto, melammed shehabbaal yoresh et ishto.

Uleman denafka leh mishsheero", hay "vehaavartem" may aved leh? mibbee leh lechidtanya – rabbi omer: bechullan neemar bahen "netina", vechan neemra bahen "haavara"; sheen lecha shemmaavir nachala mishshevet leshevet ella bat, hoil uvenah uvalah yorshin otah.
Umimmay dishero" ze haav? dichtiv: "sheer avicha hi". ema: "sheero" – zo haem, dichtiv: "sheer immecha hi"!
Amar rava, amar kera: "mimmishpachto veyarash otah"; mishpachat av keruya "mishpacha", mishpachat em enah keruya "mishpacha" – dichtiv: "lemishpechotam levet avotam".

Umishpachat em enah keruya "mishpacha"?! veha ketiv: "vayhi naar mibbet lechem yehuda mimmishpachat yehuda, vehu levi, vehu gar sham" – ha gufa kashya; amrat "vehu levi" – alma millevi ate, "mimmishpachat yehuda" – alma mihuda ate! ella lav daavu millevi, veimmeh mihuda? vekaamar "mimmishpachat yehuda"!
Amar rava bar rav chanan: la; gavra dishmeh levi. i hachi, hayeynu dekaamar micha: "atta yadati ki yetiv Adonai li, ki haya li hallevi lechohen"? in, deitremi leh gavra dishmeh levi.

Vechi levi shemo?! vahalo yehonatan shemo, shenneemar: "vihonatan ben gershom ben menashshe, hu uvanav hayu chohanim leshevet haddani"! (amar leh: velitamaych) vechi ben menashshe hu?! vahalo ben moshe hu, dichtiv: "bene moshe gershom veeliezer"!
Ella mittoch sheasa maase menashshe, telao hakkatuv bimnashshe; hacha name, mittoch sheasa maase menashshe – deate mihuda, telao hakkatuv bihuda.

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: mikkan shettolin et hakkalkala bamkulekal. rabbi yose bar chanina amar, mehacha: "vegam hu tov toar meod, veoto yalda achare avshalom" – vahalo adoniyya ben chaggit veavshalom ben maacha! ella, mittoch sheasa maase avshalom – demarad bammalchut, telao hakkatuv beavshalom. hacha name, mittoch sheasa maase menashshe – telao hakkatuv bimnashshe.
Amar rabbi elazar: leolam yidbak adam battovim, shehare moshe shennasa bat yitro – yatza mimmennu yehonatan; aharon shennasa bat amminadav – yatza mimmennu pinchas.
Ufinchas lav miyyitro ate? veha ketiv: "veelazar ben aharon lakach lo mibbenot putiel lo leishsha"; may, lav deate miyyitro – sheppittem agalim laavoda zara? la, deate miyyosef – sheppitpet beyitzro.
Vahalo shevatim mevazzim oto, veomrim: reitem "ben puti" ze – ben sheppittem avi immo agalim laavoda zara, yaharog nesi shevet miyyisrael?!

a: Ella i avu deimmeh miyyosef – imma deimmeh miyyitro; i avu deimmeh miyyitro – imma deimmeh miyyosef. dayka name, dichtiv: "mibbenot putiel" – tarte shema minna.

Amar rava: hannose ishsha, tzarich sheyyivdok beacheha, shenneemar: "vayyikkach aharon et elisheva bat amminadav achot nachshon" – mimmashma shenneemar "bat amminadav", eni yodea sheachot nachshon hi? ma talmud lomar: "achot nachshon"? mikkan shehannose ishsha tzarich sheyyivdok beacheha. tana: rov banim domin laache haem.

"Vayyasuru shamma, vayyomer: mi heviacha halom, uma atta ose baze, uma lecha fo?". amru lo: lav mimmoshe ka atet, dichtiv beh: "al tikrav halom"? lav mimmoshe ka atet, dichtiv beh: "ma ze beyadcha"? lav mimmoshe ka atet, dichtiv beh: "veatta po amod immadi"? tease komer laavoda zara?!
Amar lahen, kach mekubbelani mibbet avi abba: leolam yaskir adam atzmo laavoda zara, veal yitztarech labberiyyot.
Vehu savar – laavoda zara mammash; vela hi, ella "avoda zara" – avoda shezzara lo, kedaamar leh rav lerav kahana: netosh nevelta beshuka ushekol agra, vela tema: gavra rabba ana vezila bi milleta.

Kevan sheraa david shemmamon chaviv alav beyoter, minnahu al haotzarot, shenneemar: "ushevuel ben gershom ben menashshe nagid al haotzarot". vechi shevuel shemo? vahalo yehonatan shemo! amar rabbi yochanan: sheshshav lael bechol libbo.

Vehabbanim et haav. menalan? dichtiv: "ish ki yamut vegomer". tama deen lo ben, ha yesh lo ben – ben kodem. amar leh rav pappa leabbaye, ema: i ikka ben – lerot ben, ikka bat – terot bat, ikka ben uvat – la hay lerot vela hay lerot!
Veella
b: Man kulei lerot? attu bar kashsha demata lerot?! hachi ka amena: ikka ben uvat – la hay lerot kulleh vela hay lerot kulleh, ella ki hadade lertu!

Amar leh abbaye: veitzterich kera leashmoinan hecha delet leh ella chad bera, lertinhu lechullehu nichse?! vedilma ha ka mashma lan – devat name bat yerushsha hi? hahu mivvechol bat yoreshet nachala" nafka.
Rav acha bar yaakov amar, mehacha: "lamma yiggara shem avinu mittoch mishpachto, ki en lo ben". tama deen lo ben, ha yesh lo ben – ben kodem.
Vedilma benot tzelafchad hu dekaamran hachi; nittena tora – venitchaddesha halacha! ella mechavvavrta kidshannin meikkara.
Ravina amar, mehacha: "hakkarov elav"; "hakkarov" – karov kodem.

Umay kureve deven mibbat – shebben kam tachat aviv liida velisde achuzza? yeida – bat lav bat yeida hi! sede achuzza name – mehay pircha gufa hu, deha kayyma leh letanna, kelum yesh yibbum – ella bemakom sheen ben! ella mechavvavrta kidshannin meikkara.
Vei baet ema, mehacha: "vehitnachaltem otam livnechem acharechem"; "benechem" – velo benotechem. ella meatta, "lemaan yirbu yemechem vime venechem", hachi name "benechem" – velo benotechem?
Beracha shane.
Vehaachin min haav nochalin umanchilin vechulei. menalan? amar rabba: atya "achva"–"achva" mibbene yaakov; ma lehallan, min haav velo min haem; af kan, min haav velo min haem.
Ulema li? "mimmishpachto veyarash otah" ketiv – mishpachat av keruya "mishpacha", mishpachat em enah keruya "mishpacha"!
In hachi name; vechi ittemar derabba, leinyan yibbum ittemar.
Vehaish et immo vechulei. mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan:

a: "Vechol bat yoreshet nachala mimmattot bene yisrael" – heach bat yoreshet shene mattot? ella zo sheaviha mishshevet echad veimmah mishshevet acher, umetu, virashatan.

Veen li ella bat, ben minnayin? amarta kal vachomer: uma bat, shehora kochah benichse haav – yippa kochah benichse haem; ben, sheyyippa kocho benichse haav – eno din sheyyippa kocho benichse haem? umimmakom shebbata – ma lehallan ben kodem labbat, af kan ben kodem labbat.

Rabbi yose berabbi yehuda verabbi elazar berabbi yose amru, mishshum rabbi zecharya ben hakkatztzav: echad habben veechad habbat, shavin benichse haem. may tama? dayyo labba min haddin lihyot kanniddon.
Vetanna kamma – la daresh "dayyo"?! veha "dayyo" deorayyta hu!
Detanya: middin kal vachomer ketzad? "vayyomer Adonai el moshe: veaviha yarok yarak befaneha, halo tikkalem shivat yamim?" kal vachomer lashshechina – arbaa asar!
Ella dayyo labba min haddin lihyot kanniddon.
Bealma daresh "dayyo"; veshane hacha, deamar kera: "mimmattot" – makkish matte haem lematte haav; ma matte haav – ben kodem labbat, af matte haem – ben kodem labbat.

Rav nittay savar lemebad ovada kerabbi zecharya ben hakkatztzav; amar leh shemuel: keman – kizcharya? afes zecharya. rabbi tavla avad ovada kerabbi zecharya ben hakkatztzav. amar leh rav nachman: may hay? amar leh, deamar rav chinnana bar shelemya mishshemeh derav: halacha kerabbi zecharya ben hakkatztzav. amar leh: zil ahdar (bach), vei la – mappekna lach rav chinnana bar shelemya meunnaych!

Rav huna bar chiyyay savar lemebad ovada kerabbi zecharya ben hakkatztzav; amar leh rav nachman: may hay? amar leh, deamar rav huna amar rav: halacha kerabbi zecharya ben hakkatztzav. amar leh: eshlach leh? ikkesif. amar leh: hasheta ki nach nafsheh derav huna, aytrest lekivli.
Veihu keman savra? ki ha derav ushemuel, deamri tarvayyhu: en halacha kerabbi zecharya ben hakkatztzav.

Mistemich veazel rabbi yannay akkatpa derabbi simlay shammaeh, veate rabbi yehuda nesia leappayyhu. amar leh: bar inash daata lekivlana, hu yae, vegulleteh yae. ki meta legabbeh, gashshesha, amar leh: den – shiureh kesak.

Bea minneh: minnayin leven shekkodem labbat benichse haem? amar leh, dichtiv: "mattot" – makkish matte haem lematte haav; ma matte haav – ben kodem labbat, af matte haem – ben kodem labbat. amar leh: i – ma matte haav, bechor notel pi shenayim; af matte haem, bechor notel pi shenayim?!
b: Amar leh leshammaeh: gud, let den tzave lemelaf. vetama may? amar abbaye, amar kera: "bechol asher yimmatze lo"; "lo" – velo lah.
Veema: hane mille bachur shennasa almana, aval bachur shennasa betula – hachi name deshakel!
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak, amar kera: "reshit ono"; "ono" – velo onah.
Hahu mibbaya leh labba achar nefalim, deleheve bechor lenachala – mi shellibbo davev alav, yatza ze sheen libbo davev alav!
Im ken, lema kera: "ki hu reshit on" – may "ono"? shema minna tarte.
Veakkatti, ema hane mille almon shennasa betula, aval bachur shennasa betula – hachi name deshakel!
Ella amar rava, amar kera: "lo mishpat habbechora" – mishpat habbechora laish, velo mishpat habbechora laishsha.

Vehaish et ishto vechulei. menahane mille? detanu rabbanan: "sheero" – zo ishto, melammed shehabbaal yoresh et ishto. yachol af hi tirashennu? talmud lomar: "veyarash otah" – hu yoresh otah, veen hi yoreshet oto.
Veha kerae lav hachi ketivi! amar abbaye, taretz hachi: "unetattem et nachalato lakkarov elav, sheero veyarash otah".
Amar rava: sakkina charifa mafseka kerae?! ella amar rava, hachi kaamar: "unetattem et nachalat sheero lo" – ka savar gorin umosifin, vedorshin.
Vehay tanna mayyte la mehacha – detanya: "veyarash otah", melammed shehabbaal yoresh et ishto; divre rabbi akiva.
Rabbi yishmael omer: eno tzarich, hare hu omer: "vechol bat yoreshet nachala mimmattot bene yisrael, leechad mimmishpachat vegomer" – bahasavat habbaal hakkatuv medabbar.
Veomer: "velo tissov nachala livne yisrael mimmatte el matte". veomer: "velo tissov nachala mimmatte lematte acher".
Veomer: "veelazar ben aharon met, vayyikberu oto begivat pinchas beno" – vechi minnayin lefinchas shello haya lo leelazar? ella melammed shennasa pinchas ishsha umeta, virashah.
Veomer: "useguv holid et yair, vayhi lo esrim veshalosh arim beeretz haggilad" –

a: Vechi minnayin leyair shello haya lo lisguv? melammed shennasa yair ishsha umeta, virashah.
May "veomer"? vechi tema, besibbat habben ka kafed kera, aval baal la yaret – ta shema: "velo tissov nachala livne yisrael mimmatte lematte".
Vechi tema, laavor alav belav vaase – ta shema: "lo tissov nachala mimmatte lematte acher".
Vechi tema, laavor alav bishne lavin vaase – ta shema: "veelazar ben aharon met vegomer".
Vechi tema, elazar hu dinsev itteta umeta, veyarta pinchas – ta shema: "useguv holid et yair vegomer".
Vechi tema, hatam name hachi hu – im ken, tere kerae lema li?
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: mimmay? dilma leolam ema lach: baal la yaret; ukerae – besibbat habben, kidshanninan; veyair, dizvan mizban; ufinchas name, dizvan mizban!
Amar leh: pinchas dizvan mizban la matzet amrat; deim ken, nimtzet sade chozeret bayyovel, venimtza tzaddik kavur bekever sheeno shello.
Ella ema dinfala leh missede charamim!
Amar abbaye: sof sof, ha ka mitakra nachala mishshivta deimma leshivta deabba!
Umimmay? vedilma shane hatam, shekkevar husabba! amar leh: "shekkevar husabba" la amrinan.
Amar leh rav yemar lerav ashe: i amrat bishlama shekkevar husabba, hayeynu demittokma kera ben besibbat habben, ben besibbat habbaal.
Ella i amrat la amrinan shekkevar husabba, ki minnasva leechad mimmishpachat matte aviha, may have? ha mitakra nachala mishshivta deimma leshivta deabba!
Demansevinan la legavra daavuhi mishshivta daavuha veimmeh mishshivta deimmeh.
b: I hachi, hay "leechad mimmishpachat matte aviha veimmah" mibbee leh! i ketiv hachi, hava amena afillu ippecha, ka mashma lan.
Tanya besibbat habben, vetanya besibbat habbaal; tanya besibbat habben: "velo tissov nachala livne yisrael mimmatte el matte" – besibbat habben hakkatuv medabbar.

Atta omer: besibbat habben; o eno ella besibbat habbaal? keshehu omer: "velo tissov nachala mimmatte lematte acher", hare besibbat habbaal amur; ha ma ani mekayyem "velo tissov nachala livne yisrael mimmatte el matte" – besibbat habben hakkatuv medabber.

a: Tanya iddach: "velo tissov nachala mimmatte lematte acher" – besibbat habbaal hakkatuv medabber.

Atta omer besibbat habbaal; o eno ella besibbat habben? keshehu omer: "velo tissov nachala livne yisrael mimmatte el matte" – hare hasibbat habben amur; ha ma ani mekayyem "velo tissov nachala mimmatte lematte acher"? besibbat habbaal hakkatuv medabber.
Dechulle alma mihat, "mimmatte lematte acher" – besibbat habbaal hakkatuv medabber; may mashma? siman amar rabba bar rav shela, amar kera: "ish". tarvayyhu "ish" ketiv behu!
Ella amar rav nachman bar yitzchak, amar kera: "yidbeku". tarvayyhu "yidbeku" ketiv behu!
Ella amar rava, amar kera: "yidbeku mattot". rav ashe amar, amar kera: "mimmatte lematte acher" – uven lav acher hu.

Amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan amar rabbi yannay amar rabbi; umatu bah mishshemeh derabbi yehoshua ben korcha: minnayin levaal sheeno notel barauy kivmuchezak? shenneemar: "useguv holid et yair, vayhi lo esrim veshalosh arim beeretz haggilad". minnayin leyair – shello haya lo lisguv? ella melammed shennasa seguv ishsha, umeta bechayye morisheha; umetu morisheha, virashah yair.
Veomer: "veelazar ben aharon met vayyikberu vegomer". minnayin lefinchas – shello haya lo leelazar? melammed shennasa elazar ishsha, umeta bechayye morisheha; umetu morisheha, virashah pinchas.

Umay "veomer"? vechi tema, yair – dahava nesiv itteta umeta, veyarta; talmud lomar: veelazar ben aharon met". vechi tema dinfala leh bisde charamim, amar kera: "beno" – nachala haruya lo, virashah beno.
Uvene achot. tana: bene achot, velo benot achot.
b: Lemay hilcheta? amar rav sheshet: lekaddem.
Tane rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak kammeh derav huna: "veyarash" – makkish yerushsha sheniyya lirushsha rishona; ma yerushsha rishona – ben kodem labbat, af yerushsha sheniyya – ben kodem labbat.

Tane rabba bar chanina kammeh derav nachman: "vehaya beyom hanechilo et banav" – bayom atta mappil nachalot, vei atta mappil nachalot ballayla. amar leh abbaye: ella meatta, deshachev bimama hu deyarti leh beneh, man deshachev belelya la yarti leh beneh?!
Dilma din nachalot ka amrat? detanya: "vehayta livne yisrael lechukkat mishpat" – ora kol happarasha kullah lihyot din.
Vechidrav yehuda, deamar rav yehuda: shelosha shennichnesu levakker et hachole, ratzu – kotvin, ratzu – osin din. shenayim – kotvin veen osin din. veamar rav chisda: lo shanu ella bayyom;

a: Aval ballayla, afillu shelosha – kotvin veen osin din. may tama? dehavu lehu edim, veen ed naase dayyayn. amar leh: in, hachi name kaamena.
Ittemar: kinyan, ad ematay chozer? rabba amar: kol zeman sheyyoshvin. rav yosef amar: kol zeman sheoskin beoto inyan.
Amar rav yosef: kevoti didi mistabbera, deamar rav yehuda: shelosha shennichnesu levakker et hachole – ratzu kotvin, ratzu osin din. vei salka datach kol zeman sheyyoshvin, lechush dilma hadar beh!
Amar rav ashe: amrita lishmata kammeh derav kahana; ulerav yosef mi nicha?! velechush dilma hadar beh! ella may it lach lememar – disliku
b: Meinyana leinyana; hachi name, dekamu vahadar yetivu. vehilcheta kevoteh derav yosef besade, inyan umechetza.
Haishsha et benah vechulei. ha tu lema li? ha tena leh resha: haish et immo, vehaish et ishto!

Ha ka mashma lan – deishsha et benah, dumeya deishsha et balah; ma ishsha et balah – en habbaal yoresh et ishto bakkever, af ishsha et benah – en habben yoresh et immo bakkever, lehanechil laachin min haav.

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yehuda ben rabbi shimon: devar tora – haav yoresh et beno, veishsha yoreshet et benah; shenneemar: "mattot" – makkish matte haem lematte haav, ma matte haav – av yoresh et beno, af matte haem – ishsha yoreshet et benah.

a: Etiveh rabbi yochanan lerabbi yehuda ben shimon: haishsha et benah, vehaishsha et balah, vaache haem – manchilin velo nochalin! amar leh: mishnatenu, eni yodea mi shenaah.
Velema leh: rabbi zecharya ben hakkatztzav hi, dela daresh "mattot"!
La mittokma matnitin kerabbi zecharya ben hakkatztzav; dekatane: "uvene achot", vetana: "bene achot" – velo benot achot. veamrinan: lemay hilcheta? veamar rav sheshet: lekaddem.
Vei salka datach matnitin rabbi zecharya ben hakkatztzav hi, ha amar: echad habben veechad habbat shavin benichse haem!
Vetanna didan – mimma nafshach; i daresh "mattot", ishsha name tirash et benah; i la daresh "mattot", ben dekodem labbat benichse haem – mena leh?
Leolam daresh "mattot"; veshane hacha, deamar kera: "vechol bat yoreshet nachala" – yoreshet, veenah moreshet.

Mishna seder nachalot kach hu: "ish ki yamut uven en lo, vehaavartem et nachalato levitto" – ben kodem labbat, kol yotze yerecho shel ben kodmin labbat. bat kodemet laachin, yotze yerechah shel bat kodmin laachin. achin kodmin laache haav, yotze yerechan shel achin kodmin laache haav.
Ze hakkelal: kol hakkodem bannachala – yotze yerecho kodmin. vehaav kodem lechol yotze yerecho.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "ben" – en li ella ben; ben habben, o bat habben, o ben bat habben – minnayin? talmud lomar: "en lo" – ayyen alav.
"Bat" – en li ella bat; bat habbat, uven habbat, uvat ben habbat – minnayin? talmud lomar: "en lo" – ayyen alav.
b: Ha ketzad? nachala memashmeshet veholechet, ad reuven. velema ad yaakov! amar abbaye: gemiri dela kale shivta.

Amar rav huna amar rav: kol haomer tirash bat im bat habben, afillu nasi shebbeyisrael – en shomin lo, sheenan ella maase tzadokin. detanya: bearbaa veesrim betevet tavna ledinana. shehayu tzadokin omrin: tirash habbat im bat habben.

Nitpal lahen rabban yochanan ben zakkay, amar lahem: shotim, minnayin ze lachem? velo haya adam shehechziro davar, chutz mizzaken echad shehaya mefatpet kenegdo, veomer: uma bat beno habbaa mikkoach beno – tirashennu; bitto habbaa mikkocho – lo kol shekken?
Kara alav et hammikra hazze: "elle vene seir hachori yoshve haaretz: lotan veshoval vetzivon vaana", uchetiv: "elle bene tzivon, veayya vaana"! ella melammed shebba tzivon al immo, veholid ana.

Vedilma tere ana havo! amar rabba: amena milleta dela amra shabbur malka; umannu? shemuel. ikka deamri, amar rav pappa: amena milleta dela amra shabbur malka; umannu? rabba. amar kera: "hu ana" – hu ana demeikkara.
Amar leh: rabbi, bechach atta potreni?! amar lo: shote,

a: Velo tehe tora shelema shellanu, kesicha betela shellachem. ma levat beno – shekken yippa kochah bimkom haachin; tomar bevitto – shehora kochah bimkom achin. venitztzechum, veoto hayyom asauhu yom tov.
"Vayyomru yerushshat peleta levinyamin, velo yimmache shevet miyyisrael" –
Amar rabbi yitzchak deve rabbi amme: melammed shehitnu al shevet binyamin, shello tirash bat habben im haachin.

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: kol sheeno manniach ben leyorsho – hakkadosh baruch hu male alav evra. ketiv hacha: "vehaavartem et nachalato", uchetiv hatam: "yom evra hayyom hahu".
"Asher en chalifot lamo velo yaru elohim" – rabbi yochanan verabbi yehoshua ben levi, chad amar: kol sheeno manniach ben. vechad amar: kol sheeno manniach talmid.
Tistayyem rabbi yochanan deamar talmid – deamar rabbi yochanan: den garmeh daasiraa bir. tistayyem derabbi yochanan deamar talmid.
Umidderabbi yochanan amar talmid – rabbi yehoshua ben levi amar ben?!

Veha rabbi yehoshua ben levi la azel leve tamya ella leve man deshachev bela bene, dichtiv: "bechu vacho laholech", veamar rav yehuda amar rav: laholech belo ben zachar! ella rabbi yehoshua ben levi hu deamar talmid.
Umidderabbi yehoshua ben levi hu deamar talmid – rabbi yochanan amar ben?!
Kashya derabbi yochanan adderabbi yochanan! la kashya, ha dideh, ha derabbeh.
(Siman: hadad, ani vechacham.)

Darash rabbi pinchas ben chama, may dichtiv: "vahadad shama bemitzrayim ki shachav david im avotav, vechi met yoav sar hatztzava"? mippene ma bedavid neemra bo "shechiva", uveyoav neemra bo "mita"? david, shehinniach ben – neemra bo shechiva. yoav, shello hinniach ben – neemra bo mita.
Veyoav lo hinniach ben?! vehachtiv: "mibbene yoav – ovadya ben yechiel"! ella: david, shehinniach ben kemoto – neemra bo "shechiva". yoav, shello hinniach ben kemoto – neemra bo "mita".

Darash rabbi pinchas ben chama: kasha aniyyut betoch beto shel adam, yoter mechamishshim makkot – shenneemar: "chonnuni chonnuni attem reay, ki yad eloah naga bi", veka amri leh chavreh: "hishshamer al tefen el aven, ki al ze bacharta meoni".
Darash rabbi pinchas bar chama: kol sheyyesh lo chole betoch beto, yelech etzel chacham vivakkesh alav rachamim – shenneemar: "chamat melech malache mavet, veish chacham yechapperenna".

Ze hakkelal: kol hakkodem bannachala – yotze yerecho kodmin, vehaav kodem lechol yotze yerecho. bae rame bar chama: avi haav vaache haav – kegon avraham veyishmael benichse esav, eze mehen kodem? amar rava, ta shema: haav kodem lechol yotze yerecho. verame bar chama –
b: Aggav churepeh la ayyen bah.

Bae rame bar chama: avi haav veachiv – kegon avraham veyaakov benichse esav, eze mehen kodem? amar rava, ta shema: haav kodem lechol yotze yerecho. verame bar chama – yotze yerecho shello, velo yotze yerecho shel beno.
Hachi name mistabbera, dekatane: ze hakkelal, kol hakkodem bannachala – yotze yerecho kodmin; veillu iteh leyitzchak – yitzchak kodem, hasheta name deleteh yitzchak – yaakov kodem; shema minna.
Mishna benot tzelafchad natlu shelosha chalakim bannachala: chelek avihen – shehaya im yotze mitzrayim, vechelko im echav benichse chefer, veshehaya bechor notel shene chalakim.

a: Gemara tenan keman deamar leyotze mitzrayim nitchalleka haaretz –

Detanya, rabbi yoshiyya omer: leyotze mitzrayim nitchalleka haaretz, shenneemar: "lishmot mattot avotam yinchalu". ella ma ani mekayyem "laelle techalek haaretz benachala"? "laelle" – kaelle, lehotzi et hattefalim.

Rabbi yonatan omer: levae haaretz nitchalleka haaretz, shenneemar: "laelle techalek haaretz benachala". ella ma ani mekayyem "lishmot mattot avotam yinchalu"? meshunna nachala zo mikkol nechalot shebbaolam; shekkol nechalot shebbaolam – chayyin yorshin metim, vechan – metim yorshin chayyin.

Amar rabbi: emshol lecha mashal, lema haddavar dome? lishne achin kohanim shehayu beir achat, leechad yesh lo ben echad, veechad yesh lo shene vanim, vehalchu laggoren. ze sheyyesh lo ben echad – notel chelek echad, veze sheyyesh lo shene vanim – notel shene chalakim. umachzirin etzel avihen, vechozrin vecholkin beshave.
Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer:
b: Leellu uleellu nitchalleka haaretz, kede lekayyem shene mikraot hallalu – ha ketzad? haya miyyotze mitzrayim – notel chelko im yotze mitzrayim, haya mibbae haaretz – notel chelko im bae haaretz, mikkan umikkan – notel chelko mikkan umikkan.
Meraggelim – yehoshua vechalev natlu chelkam. mitlonnim vaadat korach – lo haya lahem chelek baaretz; habbanim natlu bizchut avi avihen, uvizchut avi immotehen.

May mashma dehay: "lishmot mattot avotam" – beyotze mitzrayim ketiv? dilma lishvatim kaamar la! dichtiv: "venatatti otah lachem morasha ani Adonai" – yerushsha hi lachem meavotechem; uleyotze mitzrayim kaamar lehu.
(Siman: larav, tzelafchad, veyosef, ikkefal, menashshe, yechashshev.)
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: bishlama leman deamar leyotze mitzrayim nitchalleka haaretz, hayeynu dichtiv: "larav tarbe nachalato velamat tamit nachalato".

a: Ella leman deamar levae haaretz, may "larav tarbu nachalato"? kashya.
Vaamar leh rav pappa leabbaye: bishlama leman deamar leyotze mitzrayim, hayeynu deka tzavvchan benot tzelafchad. ella leman deamar levae haaretz, ammay tzavvchan? ha leteh delishkol!
Ella lachazara, velittol benichse chefer.
Bishlama leman deamar leyotze mitzrayim, hayeynu deka tzavvchan bene yosef – dichtiv: "vaydabberu bene yosef". ella leman deamar levae haaretz, may ka tzavvchi? kullehu shekul!
Mishshum tefalim dahavo nefishi lehu.

Amar abbaye: shema minna, la hava chad dela shakel; dei salka datach hava chad dela shakel, ibbei leh lemitzvavch! vechi tema: ditzvavch veahani – katveh kera, ditzvavch vela ahani – la katveh kera; ha bene yosef – detzavvchi vela ahani, vechatvinhu kera!

Hatam etza tova ka mashma lan, deibbei leh leinish leizdehore meena bisha. vehayeynu dekaamar lehu yehoshua – dichtiv: "vayyomer alehem yehoshua, im am rav atta, ale lecha hayyara". amar lehu: lechu vehachebiu atzmechem biarim, shello tishlot bachem ayin ra.
b: Amaru leh: anan mizzara deyosef, dela shalta beh ena bisha – dichtiv: "ben porat yosef, ben porat ale ayin", veamar rabbi avahu: al tikre "ale ayin", ella "ole ayin".
Rabbi yose berabbi chanina amar mehacha: "veyidgu larov bekerev haaretz"; ma dagim shebbayyam – mayim mechassim alehem veen haayin sholetet bahem, af zaro shel yosef – en haayin sholetet bahem.

Meraggelim – yehoshua vechalev natlu chelkam. menahane mille? amar ulla, deamar kera: "vihoshua bin nun vechalev ben yefunne chayu min haanashim hahem" – may "chayu"? illema chayu mammash, veha ketiv kera acharina: "velo notar mehem ish, ki im kalev ben yefunne vihoshua bin nun"! ella may "chayu" – shechayu bechelkam.

Mitlonnin vaadat korach – lo haya lahen chelek baaretz. vehatanya: meraggelim, mitlonnim vaadat korach – yehoshua vechalev natlu chelkam! la kashya; mar makkesh mitlonnim limraggelim, mar la makkesh mitlonnim limraggelim.
Detanya: "avinu met bammidbar" – ze tzelafchad. "vehu lo haya betoch haeda" – ze adat meraggelim. "hannoadim al Adonai" – ellu mitlonnim. "baadat korach" – kemashmao.
Mar makkesh mitlonnim limraggelim, umar la makkesh mitlonnim limraggelim.
Vaamar leh rav pappa leabbaye: uleman demakkesh mitlonnim limraggelim, ikkeful yehoshua vechalev viritu lechulla eretz yisrael?! amar leh: mitlonnim shebbaadat korach kaamrinan.

Vaamar leh rav pappa leabbaye: bishlama leman deamar leyotze mitzrayim nitchalleka haaretz, hayeynu dichtiv: "vayyippelu chavle menashshe asara" – shitta deshitta batte avot, vearbea didhu – ha asara.
Ella leman deamar levae haaretz, temanya hu dahavo – shitta deshitta batte avot, utere didhu – ha temanya!
Velitamaych, uleman deamar leyotze mitzrayim nitchalleka haaretz, tisha havo! ella may it lach lememar – chad acha deabba hava lehu; hachi name, tere ache deabba hava lehu –
Detanya: "naton titten lahem" zo nachalat avihen. "betoch ache avihen" – zo nachalat avi avihen. "vehaavarta et nachalat avihen lahen" – zo chelek bechora.
Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: af chelek achi avihem natlu, shenneemar: "naton titten". uleman deamar tere ache deabba hava lehu, hahu meachuzzat nachala" nafka.
Vaamar leh rav pappa leabbaye: kera may ka chashev? i tefalim ka chashev, tuva havo! i batte avot kachashev, shitta havo!

a: Leolam batte avot ka chashev, veha ka mashma lan – divnot tzelafchad natlu chelek bechora; alma eretz yisrael muchezeket hi.
Amar mar: vehabbanim natlu bizchut avi avihem, uvizchut avi immotehen. vehatanya: bizchut atzman! la kashya; ha keman deamar leyotze mitzrayim, ha keman deamar levae haaretz.
Veibbaet ema: ha veha levae haaretz, vela kashya; ha dahava ben esrim. ha dela hava ben esrim.
Veshehaya bechor notel shene chalakim. veammay? rauy hu, veen habbechor notel barauy kivmuchezak! amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: beyitdot ohalim.
Metiv rabba, rabbi yehuda omer: benot tzelafchad natlu arbaa chalakim, shenneemar: "vayyippelu chavle menashshe asara"! ella amar rabba: eretz yisrael muchezeket hi.

Metivi, amar rabbi chidka: shimon hashshikmoni haya li chaver mittalmide rabbi akiva, vechach haya rabbi shimon hashshikmoni omer: yodea haya moshe rabbenu shebbenot tzelafchad yorshot hen, aval lo haya yodea im notlot chelek bechora im lav;
Ureuya hayta parashat nachalot likkatev al yede moshe, ella shezzachu benot tzelafchad venichteva al yadan.

Veyodea haya moshe rabbenu shehamekoshesh bemita – shenneemar: "mechalleleha mot yumat", aval lo haya yodea bee zo mita hu yamut; ureuyah hayta parashat mekoshesh shettikkatev al yede moshe, ella shennitchayyev mekoshesh venichteva al yado. lelammedcha,
b: Shemmegalgelim zechut al yede zakkay, vechova al yede chayyayv.
Vei salka datach eretz yisrael muchezeket, may ka mistappeka leh?
Hi gufa ka mistappeka leh – dichtiv: "venatatti otah lachem morasha ani Adonai" – yerushsha hi lachem meavotechem; o dilma, shemmorishin veenan yorshin?

Ufeshatu leh tarvayyhu: yerushsha lachem meavotechem, umorishin veenan yorshin. vehayeynu dichtiv: "teviemo vetittaemo behar nachalatcha" – "tevienu" lo neemar, ella "teviemo"; melammed shemmitnabbein, veenan yodin ma mitnabbein.
"Vattaamodna lifne moshe velifne elazar hakkohen velifne hannesiim vechol haeda" – efshar amdu lifne moshe kulei velo amru lahen davar, veamdu lifne hannesiim vechol haeda?!
Ella sares hammikra vedorshehu, divre rabbi yoshiyya. abba chanan amar mishshum rabbi eliezer: bevet hammidrash hayu yoshvin, vehalchu veamdu lahen lifne kullan.
Bemay kamippalgi? mar savar: cholkin kavod letalmid bimkom harav, umar savar: en cholkin.
Vehilcheta: cholkin, vehilcheta: en cholkin. kashya hilcheta ahilcheta! hilcheta ahilcheta la kashya – ha diflig leh rabbeh yekara, ha dela pelig leh rabbeh yekara.
Tana: benot tzelafchad chachmaniyyot hen, darshaniyyot hen, tzidkaniyyot hen.

Chachmaniyyot hen – shellefi shaa dibberu. deamar rabbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak: melammed shehaya moshe rabbenu yoshev vedoresh befarashat yevamin, shenneemar: "ki yeshvu achim yachdav". amru lo: im keven anu chashuvin – tena lanu nachala keven; im lav – tityabbem immenu! miyyad – "vayyakrev moshe et mishpatan lifne Adonai".
Darshaniyyot hen – shehayu omrot: illu haya lo ben, lo dibbarnu. vehatanya: "bat"! amar rabbi yirmeya: semi mikkan "bat". abbaye amar: afillu haya bat labben – lo dibbarnu.
Tzidkaniyyot hen – shello nisseu ella lehagun lahen. tane rabbi eliezer ben yaakov: afillu ketanna shebbahen lo nisset pechuta mearbaim shana.

Ini?! veha amar rav chisda: nissat pechuta mibbat esrim – yoledet ad shishshim, bat esrim – yoledet ad arbaim, bat arbaim – shuv enah yoledet! ella mittoch shetztzidkaniyyot hen, naasa lahen nes – keyocheved, dichtiv: "vayyelech ish mibbet levi, vayyikkach et bat levi" –

a: Efshar bat mea usheloshim shana, vekore lah: "bat"?! deamar rabbi chama bar chanina: zo yocheved; shehoratah badderech, venolda ben hachomot – dichtiv: "asher yalda otah lelevi bemitzrayim" –

Ledatah bemitzrayim, vehoratah shello bemitzrayim. veammay karu la "bat"? amar rav yehuda bar zevida: melammed shennoldu bah simane naarut, nitadden habbasar, nitpashshetu hakkematin, vechazar hayyofi limkomo.

"Vayyikkach"?! "vayyachzor" mibbee leh! amar rav yehuda bar zevida: melammed sheasa lah maase likkuchin – hoshiva beappiryon, veaharon umiryam meshorrim lefaneha, umalache sharet omrim: "em habbanim simcha".

Lehallan menaan hakkatuv derech gedullatan, vechan derech chochmatan; mesayyeya leh lerabbi amme, deamar rabbi amme: bishiva – hallech achar chochma. bimsibba – hallech achar zikna. amar rav ashe: vehu demaflayg bechochma, vehu demaflayg bezikna.
Tana deve rabbi yishmael: benot tzelafchad shekulot hayu, shenneemar: "vattihyena" – havaya achat lechullan.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: benot tzelafchad hutteru lehinnase lechol hashshevatim, shenneemar: "lattov beenehem tihyena lenashim"; ella ma ani mekayyem "ach lemishpachat matte avihem tihyena lenashim"? etza tova hissian hakkatuv, shello yinnasu ella lehagun lahen.

Motev rabba: "emor alehem" – leotan haomdim al har sinay, "ledorotechem" – ellu dorot habbaim. im neemar avot – lamma neemar banim? veim neemar banim – lamma neemar avot? mippene sheyyesh baavot ma sheen babbanim, veyesh babbanim ma sheen baavot –

Baavot hu omer: "vechol bat yoreshet nachala"; veharebe mitzvot nitztauu banim, shello nitztauu avot. ha mippene sheyyesh baavot sheen babbanim, veyesh babbanim ma sheen baavot – hutzerach lomar avot, hutzerach lomar banim.
Katane mihat, baavot hu omer: "vechol bat yoreshet nachala"! hu motev la vehu mefarek la – levar mibbenot tzelafchad.
Amar mar, baavot hu omer: "vechol bat yoreshet nachala" – baavot in, bavanim la. may mashma? amar rava, amar kera: "ze haddavar" – davar ze lo yehe noheg ella bedor ze.
Amar leh rabba zute lerav ashe: ella meatta, "ze haddavar" dishchute chutz – hachi name dela yehe noheg ella bedor ze? shane hatam, dichtiv: "ledorotam".
b: "Ze haddavar" derashe hammattot – hachi name dela yehe noheg ella bedor ze? amar leh: hahu, yalef "ze"–"ze" mehatam.
Hay name, lelayf "ze"–"ze" mehatam! hay may? bishlama hatam, itzterich ligzera shava; hacha – lemay itzterich? lishtok kera minneh, vaana yadana dildorot hu!

May gezera shava? detanya: neemar kan: "ze haddavar", veneemar lehallan: "ze haddavar"; ma lehallan – aharon uvanav vechol yisrael, af kan – aharon uvanav vechol yisrael. uma kan – rashe hammattot, af lehallan – rashe hammattot.
Amar mar: ma lehallan aharon uvanav vechol yisrael, af kan aharon uvanav vechol yisrael. lemay hilcheta? amar rav acha bar yaakov: lomar shehafarat nedarim bishlosha hedyotot.
Veha "rashe hammattot" ketiv beh! kidamar rav chisda amar rabbi yochanan: beyachid mumeche, hachi name – beyachid mumeche.
Uma kan rashe hammattot, af lehallan rashe hammattot. lemay hilcheta? amar rav sheshet: lomar sheyyesh sheela behekdesh.
Ulevet shammay, deamri: en sheela behekdesh – ditnan, bet shammay omrim: hekdesh taut – hekdesh, uvet hillel omrim: eno hekdesh; hay "ze" veze" may avdi leh?

"Ze haddavar" dishchute chutz – mibbee leh "al hashshochet hu chayyayv, veeno chayyayv al hammolek". "ze haddavar" derashe hammattot – mibbee leh lechacham mattir, veen baal mattir. baal mefer, veen chacham mefer".
Ulevet shammay delet lehu gezera shava, hafarat nedarim bishlosha hedyotot mena lehu? nafka lehu middetanya: "vaydabber moshe et moade Adonai el bene yisrael" – rabbi yose haggelili omer:

a: Moade Adonai neemru, shabbat bereshit lo neemra. ben azzay omer: moade Adonai neemru, hafarat nedarim lo neemra.

Rabbi yose bar natan gemir la leha matnita, vela yada leh lefarosha. azal batreh derav sheshet linhardea, vela ashkecheh. azal batreh lemachoza, ashkecheh. amar leh: may "moade Adonai neemru, shabbat bereshit lo neemra"?
Amar leh: moade Adonai tzerichin kiddush bet din, shabbat bereshit enah tzericha kiddush bet din. salka datach amena: hoil uchetivi gabbe moadot, tibbee kiddush bet din kemoadot; ka mashma lan.
May "moade Adonai neemru, hafarat nedarim lo neemra"? moade Adonai tzerichin mumechin, hafarat nedarim enah tzericha mumechin.
Veha "rashe hammattot" ketiv! amar rav chisda amar rabbi yochanan: beyachid mumeche.

Tenan hatam, amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: lo hayu yamim tovim leyisrael kachamishsha asar beav ucheyom hakkippurim, shebbahen benot yerushalayim yotzot bichle lavan sheulin, shello levayyesh et mi sheen lo. bishlama yom hakkippurim – yom selicha umechila, yom shennittenu bo luchot acharonot. ella chamishsha asar beav – may hi?
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: yom shehutteru shevatim lavo ze baze. may derush? "ze haddavar" – davar ze lo yehe noheg ella bedor ze.

Rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: yom shehuttar shevet binyamin lavo bakkahal, dichtiv: "veish yisrael nishba bammitzpa lemor: ish mimmennu lo yitten bitto levinyamin leishsha". may derush? "mimmennu" – velo mibbanenu.
Rav dimi bar yosef amar rav nachman: yom shekkalu bo mete midbar; deamar mar: ad shello kalu mete midbar,
b: Lo haya dibbur im moshe – shenneemar: "vayhi kaasher tammu kol anshe hammilchama lamut mikkerev haam", usemich leh: "vaydabber Adonai elay lemor" – elay haya haddibbur.
Ulla amar: yom shebbittel bo hoshea ben ela pardesaot shehoshiv yarovam al hadderachim, shello yaalu yisrael laregel.

Rav matna amar: yom shennittenu haruge vetar likvura. deamar rav matna: oto hayyom shennittenu haruge vetar likvura – tiknu beyavne "hattov vehammetiv"; "hattov" – shello hisrichu, "vehammetiv" – shennittenu likvura.

Rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayyhu: yom shepposkin bo millichrot etzim lammaaracha. tanya, rabbi eliezer haggadol omer: kevan shehiggia chamishsha asar beav – tashash kochah shel chamma, velo hayu kortin etzim lammaaracha. amar rav menashshe: vekaru leh "yom tevar maggal".
Mikkan veelach, demosif – yosif, sheeno mosif – yesif. may "yesif"? tane rav yosef: tikbereh immeh.

Tanu rabbanan: shiva kippelu et kol haolam kullo – metushelach raa adam, shem raa metushelach, yaakov raa et shem, amram raa et yaakov, achiyya hashshiloni raa et amram, eliyyahu raa et achiyya hashshiloni – vaadayin kayyaym.
Vaachiyya hashshiloni raa et amram? veha ketiv: "velo notar mehem ish, ki im kalev ben yefunne vihoshua bin nun"!

Amar rav hamenuna: lo nigzera gezera al shivto shel levi, dichtiv: "bammidbar hazze yippelu figrechem vechol pekudechem lechol misparchem mibben esrim shana vamala" – mi sheppekudav mibben esrim; yatza shivto shel levi, sheppekudav mibben sheloshim.

Umishshear shevatim la ayuyl? vehatanya: yair ben menashshe umachir ben menashshe noldu bime yaakov, velo metu ad shennichnesu yisrael laaretz – shenneemar: "vayyakku mehem anshe haay kishloshim veshishsha ish", vetanya: sheloshim veshishsha mammash, divre rabbi yehuda.
Amar lo rabbi nechemya: vechi neemar "sheloshim veshishsha"? vahalo lo neemar ella "kishloshim veshishsha"! ella ze yair ben menashshe, sheshshakul kerubbah shel sanhedrin!

Ella amar rav acha bar yaakov: lo nigzera gezera lo al pachut mibben esrim, velo al yater mibben shishshim. lo al pachut mibben esrim – dichtiv: "mibben esrim shana umala". velo al yater mibben shishshim – gamar "umala"–"umala" mearachin; ma lehallan – yater mibben shishshim kefachut mibben esrim, af kan – yater mibben shishshim kefachut mibben esrim.
Ibbaya lehu: eretz yisrael – lishvatim ippelug, o dilma lekarkaf gavre ippelug?

a: Ta shema: "ben rav limat".

Veod, tanya: atida eretz yisrael shettitchallek lishlosha asar shevatim – shebbattechilla lo nitchalleka ella lishnem asar shevatim. velo nitchalleka ella bechesef – shenneemar: "ben rav limat". amar rabbi yehuda: sea bihuda, shava chamesh sein baggalil.
Velo nitchalleka ella begoral – shenneemar: "ach begoral". velo nitchalleka ella beurim vetummim – shenneemar: "al pi haggoral".
Ha ketzad? elazar melubbash urim vetummim, vihoshua vechol yisrael omdim lefanav; vekalpi shel shevatim vekalpi shel techumin munnachin lefanav;
Vehaya mechavven beruach hakkodesh veomer: zevulun ole, techum akko ole immo. taraf bekalpi shel shevatim – veala beyado zevulun, taraf bekalpi shel techumin – veala beyado techum akko.

Vechozer umechavven beruach hakkodesh veomer: naftali ole, utechum ginnosar ole immo. taraf bekalpi shel shevatim – veala beyado naftali, taraf bekalpi shel techumin – veala beyado techum ginnosar. vechen kol shevet vashevet.

Velo kachalukka shel olam hazze, chalukka shel olam habba. haolam hazze, adam yesh lo sede lavan – en lo sede fardes, sede fardes – en lo sede lavan. laolam habba, en lach kol echad veechad sheen lo bahar uvashshefela uvaemek, shenneemar: shaar reuven echad, shaar yehuda echad, shaar levi echad". hakkadosh baruch hu mechallek lahen beatzmo, shenneemar: "veelle machlekotam neum Adonai".
Katane mihat: "shebbattechilla lo nitchalleka ella lishnem asar shevatim"; shema minna, lishvatim ippelug! shema minna.

Amar mar: atida eretz yisrael shettitchallek lishlosha asar shevatim. iddach leman? amar rav chisda: lenasi, dichtiv: "vehaoved hair yaavduhu mikkol shivte yisrael". amar leh rav pappa leabbaye, ema runegar bealma! la salka datach, dichtiv: "vehannotar lannasi mizze umizze, litrumat hakkodesh velaachuzzat hair".
Velo nitchalleka ella lichsafim – shenneemar: "ben rav limat". lemay? illema leshufera vesanya, attu beshufetane askinan? ella likrova urechoka.
Ketannae – rabbi eliezer omer: bichsafim heeluha. rabbi yehoshua omer: bekarka heeluha.

Velo nitchalleka ella begoral – shenneemar: "ach begoral". tana: "ach begoral" – yatzu yehoshua vechalev. lemay? illema dela shekul kelal; hasheta delav didhu shekul, didhu mibbaya?! ella shello natlu begoral, ella al pi Adonai. yehoshua – dichtiv: "al pi Adonai natnu lo et hair asher shaal, et timnat serach behar efrayim".
b: Ketiv: "serach", uchetiv: "cheres"! amar rabbi elazar: battechilla peroteha kecheres, ulevassof peroteha masrichin. veikka deamri: battechilla masrichin, ulevassof kecheres.

Kalev – dichtiv: "vayyittenu lechalev et chevron kaasher dibber moshe, vayyoresh mishsham et shelosha bene haanak". chevron ir miklat havay! amar abbaye: parvvraha, dichtiv: "veet sede hair veet chatzereha natnu lechalev ben yefunne baachuzzato".

Mishna echad habben veechad habbat bannachala; ella shehabben notel pi shenayim benichse haav, veeno notel pi shenayim benichse haem. vehabbanot – nizzonot minnichse haav, veenan nizzonot minnichse haem.
Gemara may "echad habben veechad habbat lenachala"? illema deyarti ki hadade, ha tenan: ben kodem labbat, kol yotze yerecho shel ben kodmin labbat!
(Siman: nafsham.) amar rav nachman bar yitzchak, hachi kaamar: echad habben veechad habbat notlin barauy kivmuchezak.
Ha name tenena: benot tzelafchad natlu shelosha chalakim bannachala – chelek avihen shehaya miyyotze mitzrayim, vechelko im echav benichse chefer!
Veod, may "ella"?
Ella amar rav pappa, hachi kaamar: echad habben veechad habbat notlin chelek bivchora.
Ha name tenena: veshehaya bechor notel shene chalakim! veod, may "ella"?
Ella amar rav ashe, hachi kaamar: echad ben ben habbanim veechad bat ben habbanot, im amar: "yirash kol nechasay" – devarav kayyaymin.
Keman, kerabbi yochanan ben beroka?! ha katane la lekamman – rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: im amar al mi sherauy leyorsho – devarav kayyaymin, al mi sheeno rauy leyorsho – en devarav kayyaymin!
Vechi tema: ka satam lan kerabbi yochanan ben beroka; setam veachar kach machaloket hi, usetam veachar kach machaloket – en halacha kassetam!
Veod, may "ella"?
Ella amar mar bar rav ashe, hachi kaamar: echad habben veechad habbat shavin benichse haem uvenichse haav, ella shehabben notel pi shenayim benichse haav, veeno notel pi shenayim benichse haem.
Tanu rabbanan: "latet lo pi shenayim" – pi shenayim keechad. atta omer pi shenayim keechad, o eno ella pi shenayim bechol hannechasim? vedin hu –

a: Chelko im echad, vechelko im chamishsha; ma chelko im echad – pi shenayim keechad, af chelko im chamishsha – pi shenayim keechad!
O kelach lederech zo – chelko im echad, vechelko im chamishsha; ma chelko im echad – pi shenayim bechol hannechasim, af chelko im chamishsha – pi shenayim bechol hannechasim!
Talmud lomar: "vehaya beyom hanechilo et banav" – hattora ribbeta nachala etzel achin; ha en alecha ladun kallashon haacharon, ella kallashon harishon.

Veomer: "uvene reuven bechor yisrael, ki hu habbechor, uvechallelo yetzue aviv nittena bechorato livne yosef ben yisrael, velo lehityaches labbechora", veomer: "ki yehuda gavar beechav ulenagid mimmennu, vehabbechora leyosef" –
Neemra "bechora" leyosef, veneemra "bechora" ledorot; ma bechora haamura leyosef – pi shenayim keechad, af bechora haamura ledorot – pi shenayim keechad.

Veomer: "vaani natatti lecha shechem achad al achecha, asher lakachti miyyad haemori becharbi uvekashti" – vechi becharbo uvekashto lakach?! vahalo kevar neemar: "ki lo vekashti evtach, vecharbi lo toshieni"! ella "charbi" – zo tefilla, "kashti" – zo bakkasha.
May "veomer"? vechi tema hay lechidrabbi yochanan ben beroka hu daata – ta shema: "uvene reuven bechor yisrael".
Vechi tema "bechora" mibbechorato" la gamrinan – ta shema: "vehabbechora leyosef".
Vechi tema: yosef gufeh – mimmay defi shenayim keechad hava? ta shema: "vaani natatti lecha shechem achad al achecha".
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: ema dikla bealma! amar leh, alecha amar kera: "efrayim umenashshe – kiruven veshimon yihyu li".
Bea minneh rabbi chelbo merabbi shemuel bar nachmani: ma raa yaakov shennatal bechora meruven, unetanah leyosef? ma raa?! "uvechallelo yetzue aviv" ketiv! ella ma raa shennetanah leyosef?

Emshol lecha mashal, lema haddavar dome? levaal habbayit sheggiddel yatom betoch beto; leyamim heeshir oto yatom, veamar: ahannehu levaal habbayit minnechasay. amar leh: vei lav dachata reuven, la mehanne leh leyosef vela middaam?!

Ella rabbi yonatan rabbach lo kach amar – reuya hayta bechora latzet merachel, dichtiv: "elle toldot yaakov, yosef", ella shekkedamattah lea berachamim; umittoch tzeniut shehayta bah berachel, hechzirah hakkadosh baruch hu lah.

May "kedamattah lea berachamim"? dichtiv: "veene lea rakkot" – may "rakkot"? illema rakkot mammash, efshar bignut behema temea lo dibber hakkatuv, dichtiv: "min habbehema hattehora umin habbehema asher enenna tehora"; bignut tzaddikim dibber hakkatuv?! ella amar rabbi elazar: shemmattenoteha arukkot.

Rav amar: leolam rakkot mammash, velo genay hu lah, ella shevach hu lah. shehayta shomaat al parashat derachim bene adam shehayu omrim: shene vanim yesh lah lerivka, shete vanot yesh lo lelavan, gedola laggadol uketanna lakkatan.
Vehayta yoshevet al parashat derachim umeshaelet: gadol ma maasav? ish ra hu melastem beriyyot. katan ma maasav? "ish tam yoshev ohalim". vehayta bocha, ad shennashru rise eneha.

Vehayeynu dichtiv: "vayyar Adonai ki senua lea" – may "senua"? illema senua mammash; efshar bignut behema temea lo dibber hakkatuv, bignut tzaddikim dibber hakkatuv?! ella raa hakkadosh baruch hu shessenuin maase esav befaneha, "vayyiftach et rachmah".

Umay tzeniut hayta bah berachel? dichtiv: "vayyagged yaakov lerachel ki achi aviha hu, vechi ven rivka hu" vahalo ben achot aviha hu! ella amar la: minnasvat li? amara leh: in, mihu abba rammaa hu, vela yachlat leh.

Amar la: may rammauteh? amara leh: it li achata dekashshisha minnay, vela manseva li mikkamma. amar la: achiv ani berammaut. amara leh: umi shere lehu letzaddike lesaggoye berammauta? in, "im navar tittavar veim ikkesh tittappal"; mesar la simanin.

Ki ka meayyeyli la lelea, savra: hasheta mikkasfa achatay. mesartinhu nihala. vehayeynu dichtiv: "vayhi vabboker vehinne hi lea" – mikkelal dead hasheta lav lea hi?! ella mittoch simanim shemmasar lah yaakov lerachel, umesaratan lelea – la hava yada la ad hahi shata.

Bea minneh abba chalifa kirvaya merabbi chiyyay bar abba: bichlalan – atta motze shivim; bifratan – atta motze shivim chaser echad! amar leh: teoma hayta im dina, dichtiv: "veet dina vitto". ella meatta, teoma hayta im binyamin – dichtiv:
b: "Veet binyamin achiv ben immo"?! amar: margalit tova hayta beyadi, veatta mevakkesh leabbedah mimmenni; hachi amar rabbi chama bar chanina: zo yocheved – shehoratah badderech, veledatah ben hachomot; shenneemar: "asher yalda otah lelevi bemitzrayim" – ledatah bemitzrayim, veen horataהּ bemitzrayim.

Bea minneh rabbi chelbo merabbi shemuel bar nachmani, ketiv: "vayhi kaasher yalda rachel et yosef vegomer" – may shena ki ityelid yosef? amar leh: raa yaakov avinu sheen zaro shel esav nimsar ella beyad zaro shel yosef, shenneemar: "vehaya vet yaakov esh, uvet yosef lehava, uvet esav lekash vegomer".

Etiveh: "vayyakkem david mehanneshef vead haerev lemochoratam"! amar leh: deakreyach nevie la akreyach ketuve; dichtiv: "belechto el tziklag, naflu alav mimmenashshe adna veyozavad vidiael umichael veyozavad veelihu vetzilletay – rashe haalafim asher limnashshe".

Metiv rav yosef: "umehem min bene shimon halchu lehar seir anashim chamesh meot, ufelatya unearya urefaya veuzziel bene yishi berosham, vayyakku et sheerit happeleta laamalek, vayyeshvu sham ad hayyom hazze"! amar rabba bar shela: yishi mibbene menashshe ate, dichtiv: "uvene menashshe chefer veyishi".
Tanu rabbanan: habbechor notel pi shenayim bazzeroa uvallechayayim uvakkeva, uvemukedashin, uveshevach sheshshavchu nechasim leachar mitat avihen.
Ketzad? hinniach lahen avihen para muchekeret umusekeret beyad acherim, o shehayta roa baafar; veyalda – bechor notel pi shenayim. aval banu battim venatu keramim – en bechor notel pi shenayim.
Hay hazzeroa vehallechayayim vehakkeva – hechi dame? i deate lide avuhon, peshita! vei dela ate lide avuhon, rauy hu – veen habbechor notel barauy kivmuchezak!
Hacha bemakkire chehunna askinan, udeishtechit bechayye daavuhon; vekasavar: mattanot shello huremu, kemi shehuremu damu.
Mukedashin – lav dideh ninhu!
Bekadashim kallim, veallibba derabbi yose haggelili – deamar: mamon bealim hu. detanya: "umaala maal baAdonai" – lerabbot kodashim kallim, shehen mamon bealim; divre rabbi yose haggelili.

Hinniach lahen avihen para muchekeret umusekeret beyad acherim, o shehayta roa baafar; veyalda – bechor notel bah pi shenayim. hasheta muchekeret umusekeret – delav birshuta demara didhu kayyma, amrat shakel; roa baafar mibbaya?!
Ha ka mashma lan – demuchekeret umusekeret, dumeya deroa baafar; ma roa baafar – shevacha demimmela ka ate, vela ka chasri ba mezona;

a: Af muchekeret umusekeret – shevacha demimmela ka ate, dela chasri ba mezone.

Manni – rabbi hi, detanya: en bechor notel pi shenayim beshevach sheshshavchu nechasim leachar mitat avihen. rabbi omer, omer ani: bechor notel pi shenayim beshevach sheshshavchu nechasim leachar mitat avihen, aval lo beshevach shehishbichu yetomim leachar mitat avihen.
Yarshu shetar chov – bechor notel pi shenayim. yatza alehen shetar chov – bechor noten pi shenayim. veim amar: "eni noten, veeni notel" – rashshay.
May tamayyhu derabbanan? amar kera: "latet lo pi shenayim" – "mattana" karyeh rachamana; ma mattana – ad dematya lideh, af chelek bechora – ad dematya lideh.
Verabbi omer, amar kera: "pi shenayim" – makkish chelek bechora lechelek pashut; ma chelek pashut – af al gav dela meta lideh, af chelek bechora – af al gav dela meta lideh.
Verabbanan name, hachtiv: "pi shenayim"! hahu lemitteva leh achad mitzra.
Verabbi name hachtiv: "latet lo"! hahu sheim amar: "eni notel veeni noten" – rashshay.

Amar rav pappa: dikla vaalem, ara veassek sirton – dechulle alma la peligi deshakel. ki peligi – bachafura vahava shuvele, shelufefe vahavo tamre; demar savar: shevacha demimmela, umar savar: ishtanni.
Amar rabba bar chana amar rabbi chiyyay: asa kedivre rabbi – asa. kedivre chachamim – asa.
b: Mesappeka leh i halacha kerabbi mechavero – velo mechaverav; o halacha kerabbi mechavero – vaafillu mechaverav.
Amar rav nachman amar rav: asur laasot kedivre rabbi. ka savar: halacha kerabbi mechavero – velo mechaverav.
Verav nachman dideh amar: muttar laasot kedivre rabbi. ka savar: halacha kerabbi mechavero – vaafillu mechaverav.
Amar rava: asur laasot kedivre rabbi, veim asa – asuy. ka savar: mattin ittemar.

Tane rav nachman bishar sifre deve rav: "bechol asher yimmatze lo" – perat leshevach shehishbichu yorshin leachar mitat avihen. aval shevach sheshshavchu nechasim leachar mitat avihen – shakel. umanni – rabbi hi.

Tane rame bar chama bishar sifre deve rav: "bechol asher yimmatze lo" – perat leshevach sheshshavchu nechasim leachar mitat avihen, vechol shekken shevach shehishbichu yorshin leachar mitat avihen – dela shakel. umanni – rabbanan hi.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: en bechor notel pi shenayim bammilva. leman? illema lerabbanan, hasheta shevacha deiteh birshuteh – amri rabbanan la shakel; milva mibbaya?!
Ella lerabbi.
Veella ha detanya: yarshu shetar chov – bechor notel pi shenayim, ben bammilva ben baribbit. manni? la rabbi vela rabbanan!
Leolam lerabbanan, veitzterich – salka datach amena: milva – kevan denaket shetara, keman degavya damya; ka mashma lan.
Shelachu mittam: bechor notel pi shenayim bammilva, aval lo baribbit.
Leman? illema lerabbanan, hasheta shevacha deiteh birshuteh – amri rabbanan dela shakel; milva mibbaya?!
Ella lerabbi. ulerabbi, baribbit la?! vehatanya, rabbi omer: bechor notel pi shenayim, ben bammilva ben baribbit!
Leolam rabbanan hi, umilva keman degavya damya.
Amar leh rav acha bar rav leravina: ikkela ammemar leatrin, vedaresh: bechor notel pi shenayim bammilva, aval lo baribbit. amar leh: nehardae letamayyhu –
Deamar rabba: gavu karka – yesh lo, gavu maot – en lo. verav nachman amar: gavu maot – yesh lo, gavu karka – en lo.
Amar leh abbaye lerabba: ledidach kashya, lerav nachman kashya. ledidach kashya,

a: May shena maot dela – delav hane maot shevak avuhon; karka name – lav ha karka shevak avuhon!
Veod, ha at hu deamrat: mistabber tama divne mareva, dei kedem savta vezabbena – zevina zevine!
Lerav nachman kashya, may shena karka dela – delav ha karka shevak avuhon; maot name – lav hane maot shevak avuhon!
Veod, ha amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: yetomim sheggavu karka bechovat avihen – baal chov chozer vegovah mehen!
Amar leh: la ledidi kashya, vela lerav nachman kashya; tama divne mareva kaamrinan, velan la sevira lan.
May savta? dehahu daamar lehu:
b: "Nichsay lesavta, uvatra leyartay". haveya leh beratta dahava nesiva, shechiva bechayye bala uvechayye savta. batar dishchiva savta, ata baal ka tava.
Amar rav huna: "leyartay" – vaafillu leyarte yartay. verav anan amar: "leyartay" – vela leyarte yartay.

Shelachu mittam: hilcheta kevoteh derav anan, velav mittameh. hilcheta kevoteh derav anan – devaal la yaret, velav mittameh; deillu rav anan savar: af al gav dahava leh bera livratteh, la yaret; vela hi, deillu hava leh bera livratteh, vadday yaret; uvaal hayeynu tama dela yaret – mishshum dahava leh rauy, veen habbaal notel barauy kivmuchezak.
Mikkelal derav huna savar: baal notel barauy kivmuchezak?!
Amar rabbi elazar: davar ze niftach bigdolim venistayyem biktannim, kol haomer: "acharecha", keomer "meachshav" dame.
Amar rabba: mistabbera tama divne mareva, dei kedem savta vezabbina – zevina zevine.
Amar rav pappa, hilcheta: en habbaal notel barauy kivmuchezak, veen habbechor notel barauy kivmuchezak. veen habbechor notel pi shenayim bammilva – ben sheggavu karka, ben sheggavu maot.

a: Umilva sheimmo, palgi.
Amar rav huna amar rav assi: bechor shemmicha – micha.
Amar rabba: mistabber tameh derav assi baanavim – uvetzarum, zetim – umesakum; aval derachum – la. verav yosef amar: afillu derachum.
Derachum?! meikkara inve, hasheta chamra!
Kidamar rav ukeva bar chama: litten lo deme hezzek anavav; hacha name – noten lo deme hezzek anavav.

Hecha ittemar derav ukeva bar chama? aha – deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: bechor ufashut shehinniach lahen avihen anavim, uvetzarum; zetim, umesakum – bechor notel pi shenayim, afillu derachum. derachum?! meikkara inve, hasheta chamra! amar mar ukeva bar chama: litten lo deme hezzek anavav.
Amar rav assi: bechor shennatal chelek kefashut – vitter. may "vitter"? rav pappa mishshemeh derava amar: vitter beotah sade. rav pappi mishshemeh derava amar: vitter bechol hannechasim kullan.
Rav pappa mishshemeh derava amar: vitter beotah sade – ka savar: en lo labbechor kodem chalukka; uma daata lideh – achel, iddach la achel.
Verav pappe mishshemeh derava amar: vitter bechol hannechasim kullan – ka savar: yesh lo livchor kodem chalukka; umiddeachel beha – achel bechullehu.

Veha derav pappe verav pappa – lav beferush ittemar, ella mikkelala ittemar – dehahu bechor daazal zabben nichse dideh udefashut. azul yatme bene pashut lemechal tamre mehanhu lakochot, mechonhu. amri lehu kerovim: la missatyay dizvantinhu lenichsayyhu, ella mimche name machitu lehu? ato lekammeh derava, amar lehu: lo asa velo chelum.
b: Mar savar: lo asa kelum – befalga. umar savar: bechullehu.
Shelachu mittam: bechor shemmachar kodem chalukka – lo asa kelum. alma en lo labbechor kodem chalukka. vehilcheta: yesh labbechor kodem chalukka.
Mar zutera midderishba pelag betzanna defilpele bahade achin, beshave. ata lekammeh derav ashe, amar leh: hoil vittarta bemiktzat – vittarta bechol hannechasim kullan.
Mishna haomer: "ish peloni beni bechor lo yittol pi shenayim"; "ish peloni beni lo yirash im echav" – lo amar kelum, shehitna al ma shekkatuv battora.

Hamechallek nechasav al piv; ribba leechad umiet leechad, vehishva lahen et habbechor – devarav kayyaymin. veim amar mishshum yerushsha – lo amar kelum. katav ben battechilla ben baemtza ben bassof – mishshum mattana, devarav kayyaymin.
Gemara lema matnitin dela kerabbi yehuda? dei rabbi yehuda, haamar: bedavar shel mamon tenao kayyaym!

Detanya, haomer leishsha: "hare at mekuddeshet li, al menat sheen lich alay sheer kesut veona" – hare zo mekuddeshet, utenao batel; divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: bedavar shel mamon – tenao kayyaym!
Afillu tema rabbi yehuda: hatam yada veka machala, hacha la ka machel.
Amar rav yosef, amar: "ish peloni beni, bechori hu" – notel pi shenayim. "ish peloni bechor hu" – eno notel pi shenayim, dilma buchera deimma kaamar.

Hahu daata lekammeh derabba bar bar chana, amar leh: muchezkani baze shehu bechor. amar leh: mena yadat? dahava kare leh avu "buchera sachla". dilma buchera deimma hu, dechol buchera deimma name "buchera sachla" karu leh.

Hahu daata lekammeh derabbi chanina, amar leh: muchezkani baze shehu bechor. amar leh: mena yadat? amar leh: dechi havo atu legabbe avu, amar lehu: zilu legabbe shichchat beri, devuchera hu umasse rukkeh.
Vedilma buchera deimma hu! gemiri: buchera deabba – masse rukkeh, buchera deimma – la masse rukkeh.
Amar rabbi amme: tumetum shennikra venimtza zachar, eno notel pi shenayim; deamar kera: "vehaya habben habbechor lassenia" – ad sheyyehe ben mishsheat havaya.
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: af eno niddon keven sorer umore, deamar kera: "ki yihye leish ben sorer umore" – ad sheyyehe ben mishsheat havaya.
